Package com.sca4d.gateway.registration

Class GatewayInstanceRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.gateway.registration.GatewayInstanceRegistry
@Component public final class GatewayInstanceRegistry extends Object
管理单个 Gateway 进程内的 Server 租约、readiness 状态和轮询选择。
